§6Balefire§f

§aGreen fire that transmutes matter. Handle with extreme caution.§f

§bBalefire§f is an extremely energetic substance of unknown composition. It's pyrophoric, obscenely radioactive, and a potent energy source.

§6Sources§f:
§b• Dud bombs§f, easiest for initial euphemium production, no fueling needed, small footprint
§b• Flashgold RBMK fuel§f, spent rods yield thermonuclear ashes, §e4 ashes§f → §e1 balefire shard§f
§b• Balefire Bomb§f, generates large amounts, but destroys terrain
§b• Fusion reactor§f, antimatter-BF rocket fuel plasma produces thermonuclear ashes as a byproduct

§6Uses§f:
§b• Euphemium production§f, clusters near balefire transmute into euphemium-etched clusters
§b• RBMK fuel§f, balefire rods are among the most powerful in the mod
§b• Custom nukes§f, shards give §e15§f antimatter stage, eggs give §e150§f
§b• BF Rocket Fuel§f, chemical plant recipe: §e6,000 mB§f kerosene + shard → §e8,000 mB§f fuel + ashes

§cWARNING:§f Balefire spreads fast and kills unprotected players instantly. Never detonate near your base without proper containment. The dud method is safest for initial euphemium.
